figures.caption: Figure 2: Conceptual overview and empirical trajectory analysis of LIF-Stream. (Left) Conceptual diagram of our LIF-Stream framework for streaming SNN inference. (Right) Empirical validation on MOT17 video sequences (Milan et al., 2016) evaluated as a streaming pedestrian detection task. LIF-Stream efficiently tracks the continuous ANN output by updating only inter-frame delta, whereas standard reset-based IF and LIF-SNNs suffer from re-convergence latency overhead for every frame.
